milestones.title: Master inducible pathway for scarless, vascularized organ regeneration in adult mammals
milestones.description: A safe, controllable genetic or biomaterial switch that reactivates the embryonic/regenerative program to regrow entire complex organs (heart, kidney, limb, spinal cord) in situ with perfect architecture and function.
milestones.impact: Ends organ shortages and transplant rejection; turns trauma, stroke, and organ failure into fully reversible conditions.

milestones.title: Chronic, high-bandwidth, wireless neural interface with zero foreign-body response
milestones.description: A long-term implantable system (decades of stable recording/stimulation of millions of neurons) that integrates seamlessly without gliosis, fibrosis, or signal degradation.
milestones.impact: True bidirectional brain-computer interfaces for paralysis, blindness, deafness, and psychiatric disorders; enables thought-controlled prosthetics and memory restoration.

milestones.title: Universal, non-immunogenic, lifelong biomaterial platform for implants
milestones.description: A single material family that elicits zero immune response, zero encapsulation, and zero degradation while allowing full tissue integration for any device.
milestones.impact: Ends implant failure, revision surgeries, and immunosuppression; makes permanent bioelectronic and mechanical implants routine.

milestones.title: Portable, real-time, molecular-resolution whole-body imaging
milestones.description: A safe, non-invasive scanner (handheld or wearable-scale) that visualizes molecular events, cellular metabolism, and disease biomarkers anywhere in the body with sub-millimeter resolution in real time.
milestones.impact: Replaces most biopsies, PET/CT, and exploratory surgery; enables early detection and continuous monitoring at the point of care.

milestones.title: Fully autonomous closed-loop implantable artificial organs
milestones.description: Miniaturized, self-regulating biohybrid or mechanical organs (pancreas, kidney, liver, heart) that sense, compute, and deliver perfect physiological control indefinitely.
milestones.impact: Cures type 1 diabetes, end-stage renal disease, and heart failure without external devices or immunosuppression.

milestones.title: In-vivo 3D bioprinting or directed assembly of functional tissue
milestones.description: A minimally invasive technology that prints or assembles complete, vascularized, innervated tissues and organs directly inside the living body using patient-derived cells.
milestones.impact: On-demand repair of damaged hearts, brains, or joints; eliminates the need for donor organs and large-scale bioreactors.

milestones.title: Universal, targeted, non-viral in-vivo gene-editing and cell-reprogramming platform
milestones.description: A safe, efficient delivery vehicle that reaches any cell type in any organ with 100 % specificity, edits any gene, and reprograms cell fate without off-target effects or immune activation.
milestones.impact: One-time cures for all genetic diseases, cancers, and degenerative conditions; turns gene therapy into a routine outpatient procedure.

milestones.title: Self-powered, infection-proof, multi-modal implantable biosensor network
milestones.description: A distributed system of tiny sensors that continuously monitors every clinically relevant biomarker for decades with zero battery or external power.
milestones.impact: Proactive, personalized medicine that predicts and prevents disease in real time; enables truly closed-loop therapies.

milestones.title: Patient-specific, multi-scale biomechanical digital twin of the entire human body
milestones.description: A validated, continuously updated computational model that predicts mechanical failure, disease progression, and treatment outcomes for every tissue and organ with near-perfect accuracy.
milestones.impact: Virtual clinical trials, personalized implants, and surgical rehearsal become routine; ends unexpected device failures.

milestones.title: Synthetic universal blood substitute with full oxygen transport, clotting, and immune functions
milestones.description: An artificial oxygen carrier and plasma replacement that is shelf-stable, pathogen-free, universally compatible, and performs all functions of natural blood indefinitely.
milestones.impact: Ends blood shortages, transfusion reactions, and disease transmission; enables safe massive transfusions and battlefield medicine.
